You pick up an item from the ground.

Son la base de la accesibilidad del jueg: They are the foundation of the game's accessibility. If you change them, keep them short, clear and easy to locate in space. The locators loop from the position of an object or a mission.

It sounds with every stroke you swim.

It sounds from where the locked-on enemy is: they are within range of your weapon.

Suena en la dirección del siguiente punt: It sounds in the direction of the next point on the route. The closer you are, the faster it repeats.
Sustancias y trapicheo, solo con el cont: Substances and dealing, only with adult content

Tomas polvo blanco: una tarjeta y una in: You take white powder: a card and a sniff.

Un enemigo prepara el arma: medio segund: An enemy readies their weapon: half a second later they will fire. It also sounds when you switch weapons.
Un estampido grave y, detrás, la correde: A deep boom and, right behind it, the slide.

Un peatón murmura al hablarte, o dos que: A pedestrian murmurs as they talk to you, or two passersby chat with each other.

Un puñetazo, un batazo o un atropello qu: A punch, a bat swing or a hit-and-run that lands on someone.

Un roce o un golpe flojo con el vehículo: A scrape or a light bump with the vehicle.

A vehicle brakes hard or skids.
A vehicle or a building is on fire. If it's a vehicle, it is going to explode: get away.

Una mujer grita de susto y sale corriend: A woman yells in fright and runs off.
